title: Dual-Polarised Sedenion Zero-Divisor Jammer Excision: Machine-Checked Lean Theorems, Passive S-Parameter Stage, and CRLB Simulation (Supplement to the Sedenion GNSS Anti-Jamming Paper)
description: Supplementary deposit for the Sedenion PG(3,2) GNSS anti-jamming work. Contents: (1) lean/SedenionRobust.lean, Lean 4.15.0 / Mathlib v4.15.0, 22 theorems plus the imported SedenionReal module (whose CRPA theorems were repaired to compile) with no sorry and only the standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound): residual-leakage bounds, the constructive Moreno-cone annihilator (a,b)·(c,(ac)b)=0 imported from the PG(3,2) paper's SedenionReal.nullspace, the right-multiplication adjoint identity R(v)ᵀ=R(v*), and the closed-form dual-polarisation family v(ψ)=e3+sin2ψ·e12−cos2ψ·e15 that annihilates every complex sample of a tilt-ψ linearly polarised jammer while an RHCP satellite passes at 0 dB insertion loss, including the passive 1/√2 RF stage. (2) bench/run_dualpol_pivot12.py and its JSON results: 32-port S-matrix passivity and reciprocity, the RHCP/LHCP wiring condition (LHCP I/Q must feed the partner plane (e5,e6)), angle-of-arrival sweep against spatial MVDR and a dual-polarisation LCMV baseline (identical 3.01 dB noise gain), axial-ratio / cross-polarisation / calibration sweeps against the leakage bound, and the GPS L1 C/A code-phase CRLB. (3) DUALPOL_PIVOT12_REPORT.md with all tables and the stated limits (linearly polarised jammers only; two couplers per lane holds for canonical and tilt blades, general-position blades need fourteen).
notes: Reproduce: cd lean && lake exe cache get && lake build && lake env lean Axioms.lean; python3 bench/run_dualpol_pivot12.py out.json.
